readings.evidence: A horizontal stroke crosses the first letters of the name ('Ha…i'), not the whole word. It could be a partial cancellation or a misplaced bar; it is not ordinary underlining. The word after 'owners' looks like 'Ghan' with a strike through it. The stroke seems to start at the end of 'owners'.
